answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. This is why the honest majority can be small yet decisive: each vote carries the weight of verifiable work, not just the noise of a large flock.. The protection comes from the fact that every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, so flooding the jury floods the attacker with its own cost. Consider a kernel as the anchor of the cost.
